When it arrived I was pleased with the colorful hardback book appearance.  Until I opened the front cover!  There was a large glob of sticky glue

complaints.title: No illustrations and seems to be directed at airfryers with a basket
complaints.body: Disappointed as there were no photo illustrations and recipes although some of them sounded good seemed to be directed at a particular model of airfryer not stated though..as constantly referred to basket ..Curry was one recipe I couldn’t possibly make a curry in my airfryer many of the other recipes in the book would also be impossible think there are better books on the market..that’s my opinion

complaints.book_title: The Essential Air Fryer Cookbook: The Only Book You Need for
complaints.title: Lots of recipes and info
complaints.body: Lots of recipes and info. However, I wish there were more photos and more quick cooking charts for every day common things used in the air fryer to get to the point quickly regarding how long and how hot they need to be

complaints.book_title: The Air Fryer Cookbook: Deep-Fried Flavor Made Easy, Without
complaints.title: Good book but not what I am looking for
complaints.body: This was not what I would expect from Todd.  I really wanted a book I could use not recipes I do not make.  There, however, are reference pages in the back that became helpful..  Really need to find a book with everyday recipes in it.  I love my air fryer and would like to use it more.

complaints.book_title: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer Cookbook for Beginners
complaints.title: AI Recipes and Pics
complaints.body: This whole thing was created by AI.  It's very obvious.  Although super helpful with some of the info at the front, the rest of the recipes are meh and super basic. Which I think is the point.  You may be better off asking any of the AI engines to write you a recipe guide rather than spend your money on this.
